about.title: Who am I?
about.subtitle: I'm Guido, a Full Stack Developer
about.intro: I design and build modern web products, from scalable front ends to robust back-end services.
about.bio: I am a Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building high-availability web applications. I specialize in scalable front-end architecture, micro frontends, and end-to-end delivery. At LaserAway, I have worked on custom templates, dynamic landing pages, automated email systems, A/B testing and CRO initiatives, and headless integrations with WooCommerce and WordPress APIs. I have also built custom projects with Laravel and Next.js.
about.programmerText: I build full stack solutions using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Django, PHP, and MySQL. I also develop and optimize WordPress sites with ACF, custom themes, and API integrations. My workflow focuses on clean code, performance, and engineering best practices in agile teams.
about.experienceText: I have delivered high-impact features across marketing and product ecosystems: custom templates, landing pages, automated email systems, A/B testing and CRO initiatives, and headless API integrations for WordPress and WooCommerce.
